title: Contributing to reasin
text: Fork package clone onto computer. haven’t done , recommend using usethis::create_from_github("guardias-eu/reasin", fork = TRUE). Install development dependencies devtools::install_dev_deps(), make sure package passes R CMD check running devtools::check(). R CMD check doesn’t pass cleanly, ’s good idea ask help continuing. Create Git branch pull request (PR). recommend using usethis::pr_init("brief-description--change"). Make changes, commit git, create PR running usethis::pr_push(), following prompts browser. title PR briefly describe change. body PR contain Fixes #issue-number. user-facing changes, add bullet top NEWS.md (.e. just first header). Follow style described https://style.tidyverse.org/news.html.

what: Get species information from the EASIN's Catalogue Web Service — get_species
title: Get species information from the EASIN's Catalogue Web Service — get_species
text: function retrieves species information EASIN's Catalogue. Users can retrieve records species’ scientific name, environment, impact, taxonomy, Union concern status (LegalFramework). EASIN Web Services.

title: Get species information from the EASIN's Catalogue Web Service — get_species
code: get_species(   easin_id = NULL,   scientific_name = NULL,   environment = NULL,   country_code = NULL,   region_code = NULL,   impact = NULL,   taxon = NULL,   taxonomy = NULL,   present_in_country = NULL,   status = NULL,   horizon = NULL,   partly_native = NULL,   native_in_country = NULL,   union_concern = NULL )

title: Get species information from the EASIN's Catalogue Web Service — get_species
text: easin_id Integer. EASIN Species ID(s). scientific_name Character. Scientific name(s) part(s) . Case insensitive. environment Character. Environment type(s): one "MAR", "FRW", "TER", "OLI" filter species , marine, freshwater, terrestrial oligohaline environments respectively. country_code Character. Countries' ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code(s) filter species Member State concern. Use countries() look list country codes. Source: EASIN Catalogue Web Service documentation. states submitted species Member State concern EASIN. region_code Character. Species Outermost regions concern codes defined NUTS (Nomenclature territorial units statistics). Use regions() look list region codes. Source: EASIN Catalogue Web Service documentation. impact Character. Species impact(s). Possible values: "hi" (high) "lo" (low). taxon Character named vector taxon name(s) named taxonomic rank(s). Use ranks() look list valid ranks. Source: EASIN Catalogue Web Service documentation. taxonomy Character named vector taxonomic names named taxonomic rank. Provide right order kingdom family. Source: EASIN Catalogue Web Service documentation. present_in_country Character. One countries' ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes filter species present countries. Use countries() look list country codes. Source: EASIN Catalogue Web Service documentation. status Character. Species status code(s). Use statuses() look list country codes. Source: EASIN Catalogue Web Service documentation. horizon Logical. TRUE, returns species coming Horizon Scanning assessments. TRUE allowed. partly_native Logical. TRUE, returns specise native one EU countries. native_in_country Character. One countries' ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes filter species native countries. Use countries() look list country codes. Source: EASIN Catalogue Web Service documentation. union_concern Logical. TRUE, returns species Union concern. TRUE allowed.
